title: Six foundations of remote work
sub: Connect each term with a concrete workplace meaning
body:
Remote work

Work outside a traditional office

Distributed team

Colleagues in different locations

Onboarding

Integrating a new employee

Check-in

A brief meeting or update

Deadline

When a task must be completed

Deliverable

The completed output you provide

A deadline is the time. A deliverable is the completed output.

title: Choose the right preposition
sub: Use work as, work in and work for to describe different facts
body:
01

WORK AS

I work as a UX designer.

02

WORK IN

I work in marketing.

03

WORK FOR

I work for a remote-first startup.

RESPONSIBILITY + ROUTINE

I am responsible for generating weekly reports.
I usually start work at nine and review my tasks first.

AS = job title | IN = field | FOR = employer

title: Build a clear professional introduction
sub: Valentina Torres | Fictional example for learning
body:
Name + role

Valentina Torres | Data analyst

Company

A fintech company in Santiago

Team

A distributed remote team

Responsibilities

Weekly reports + business intelligence

Routine

Review tasks, then join a check-in

Positive closing

Excited to be part of the project

Name, role, company, responsibilities, routine, positive closing.

title: Pause, choose, then check
sub: I work ___ a content writer ___ a digital marketing agency.
body:
YOUR ANSWER

I work as a content writer for a digital marketing agency.

USE THESE FORMS

work as a project manager
responsible for
I usually start

COMPARE AND CORRECT

Replace "work in a project manager", "responsible of" and "I usually starts" with the forms above.

Pause before checking the answer. Practise each corrected sentence aloud.
